text: I complained to Kotak Mahindra Bank on 1 September 2026. The unauthorised card charge of Rs 4,250 was made on 28 August 2026. They replied on 20 October 2026 but I am not satisfied.
note: Expected dates hand-computed from RB-IOS 2026 (30-day wait, 90-day window from the later of wait end and last reply).
